• VALHALLA CALLING — Official Music Video**
“Valhalla Calling” is a cinematic Viking hip-hop anthem blending powerful rap verses, haunting female vocals, heavy drums, and an epic northern atmosphere.
Through fire, snow, storms, and battle, this song is about standing strong, carrying your name with pride, and answering the call of the north.
Song: Valhalla Calling
Artist: Ragal Ironbull
